column2: The Short‑Term Plan provides for performance measures to be adjusted to exclude the impact of certain types of
events not contemplated at the time the performance measures were set, such as significant transactions, changes
in legal or regulatory policy and other special items. In determining Verizon’s performance against the performance
measures, the Committee made adjustments to cash flow from operations for impacts associated with the 2024
tower transaction with Vertical Bridge and separation payments in connection with the Voluntary Separation
Program and adjustments to workforce diversity related to the Voluntary Separation Program.
